suites.label: Backend
suites.what: pytest: parsing, framing, storage, the camera bridge and counter, serial scanning

suites.label: Console logic
suites.what: Vitest: state, formatting, link and camera states, scene maths

suites.label: Browser
suites.what: Playwright: layout, states, keyboard, accessibility and offline checks

suites.label: Colour contrast
suites.what: Every text and control colour pair in both themes, against WCAG 2.2 AA

scenarios.title: Camera switched off
scenarios.what: The board keeps sending, but every pixel is black.
scenarios.expectation: Counts nothing, and the console says the camera is not responding.

scenarios.title: Lens covered
scenarios.what: A hand over the lens: almost black, with sensor noise.
scenarios.expectation: Counts nothing, and the console says the camera is not responding.

scenarios.title: Room lights off
scenarios.what: The scene is still there, at a seventh of its brightness.
scenarios.expectation: Counts nothing, and the console says the camera is not responding.

scenarios.title: Flat grey picture
scenarios.what: A uniform grey, with a little noise: no scene at all.
scenarios.expectation: Counts nothing, and the console says the camera is not responding.

scenarios.title: Frozen picture
scenarios.what: The same frame, over and over: the board is alive but the sensor is stuck.
scenarios.expectation: Counts nothing, and the console says the camera is not responding.

scenarios.title: Board unplugged, then a different view
scenarios.what: Twenty seconds with no frames, then a scene that is not the one it learned.
scenarios.expectation: Counts nothing while it learns the new view.

scenarios.title: Switched off, then on again
scenarios.what: Off for four seconds, back with an empty view, then one recyclable item.
scenarios.expectation: Counts that one item, once, with its own label.

scenario_note: Run with the real model on a scene built from our own training frames, not filmed: it tests the counting, not the lens.
